safety_verdicts.content: Patient has never used an epipen in the past.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies the patient has never used an EpiPen; Generated states only 'No EpiPen prescribed at this time' and does not clearly document never having used one previously.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that the patient has never used an EpiPen can obscure prior severity/history of allergic reactions and may affect future risk stratification and counseling about anaphylaxis preparedness. In this encounter, management is largely driven by current symptoms and exam, so immediate harm risk is limited.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold says patient is speaking normally; Generated does not explicitly document normal speech.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to explicitly note that the patient is speaking normally omits a supportive sign that airway compromise is unlikely, but it does not change treatment decisions when the rest of the assessment indicates stable breathing. This is primarily documentation completeness rather than a clinical safety issue.
